Name: Minimize SMAPI
Author: klatuprism
Description:
Once I have stabilized all of my mods, it gets tiring having to minimize the SMAPI console window (I'm lazy).  This mod will minimize the SMAPI console to the task bar.  Once all mods have been loaded, the main Stardew Valley window will pop at its' normal size.  It does not stop the window from appearing, it just minimize it as soon as it can.


Source Code: [url=https://github.com/Prism-99/MinimizeSMAPI]GitHub[/url]

Manifest.Name: Minimize SMAPI
Manifest.Description: Minimizes the SMAPI window when the game starts.
Manifest.Author: Prism 99
